The '''Theed plasma refinery''' was a [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] [[Refinery/Legends|refinery]] located on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]]. It had been abandoned by around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and his [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], who included [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] under the disguise of [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]] and mastermind [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], launched their plot to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during the [[Festival of Light/Legends|Festival of Light]] in Theed. During the action, Embo and Twazzi were arrested, and Derrown was "knocked out". Bane and Eval managed to transform Palpatine into a [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] with the help of a [[Multispectrum disguise suite|holographic disguise matrix]], they put him into their [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] and head to this refinery to meet up Dooku. However, Dooku was not there. Instead, the disguised Kenobi arrived, who started a short fight with Bane and Eval. He managed to defeat the two, which was followed by the arrival of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] in their speeders, followed by a squad of [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|clone shock troopers]], who arrested Bane and Eval. Palpatine was transformed back and brought back to Theed, where he and Skywalker [[Plan to kidnap Chancellor Palpatine/Legends|faced]] Dooku.
